name: Ginny Dawson
source:
My little red devil Ginny... she's almost like a little sister to me. Every since me and Tracy hooked up Ginny seemed to love me right from the get go.
And now that I'm no longer together with Tracy it almost seems to have increased somehow.

[In game description]
